qualification_scope: Empirical characterization and independent demonstration of native Blackwell GB10 command submission path on NVIDIA DGX Spark
target_platform: NVIDIA DGX Spark Grace Blackwell GB10

host_buffer.mechanism: Coherent unified LPDDR5x mapped host memory aperture

gpfifo_entry.mechanism: 8-byte GPFIFO ring entries (low 32-bit GPU VA, high 32-bit length in words and upper VA bits) at 0x200202000

pushbuffer_method_stream.mechanism: NVC06F_DMA_SEC_OP_INC_METHOD packets (SET_OBJECT method 0x000, MEM_OP_A method 0x28, SEM_ADDR_LO method 0x5c)

channel_token.mechanism: Opaque 32-bit workSubmitToken returned by RM control 0xc36f0108

usermode_notify_doorbell.mechanism: ARM64 store instruction 'str w2, [x0]' to BAR0 offset 0xbb0090 (+0x90 in HOPPER_USERMODE_A)

gpu_consumption.mechanism: Causally verified via negative perturbation: withholding doorbell blocks execution; issuing doorbell triggers execution

completion_fence_write.mechanism: Attributed to Blackwell method 0x5c (SEM_ADDR_LO) writing coherent marker with SEM_EXECUTE_OPERATION_RELEASE (0x1) and MEM_OP_D flushes

cpu_observes_result.mechanism: Coherent memory marker polled directly by CPU across NVLink-C2C interconnect

minimum_sovereign_transaction.description: Direct C submission without proprietary userspace runtimes (no CUDA stream/kernel/memcpy APIs in transaction critical path)
